name: qfd_su_lane_t_or-or1-COMMIT
purpose: SU lane cluster (64 per qfd_sp_su64_sfu) over the four CLOSED leaves (lane_h sp1 + sfu exp/rcp/rsq, main 943c39997) with the parent OUTPUT register stage chosen by the compute-die lead 07:27 (option 1): one kept flop per output pin (24 outputs, 302 flops + reset register), so the cluster's output launch no longer depends on the head's interleaved N / S pins. Results / writes +1 edge; read requests +1 edge with the answers back over one fewer relay (ot_hdc_vstream LOREG=1): read round trip and the closed head's ML alignment unchanged. Leaves NOT re-routed.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hdc_vstream_lane_t #(.WR(16), .AW(24), .NW(18), .KV_FP8(1), .ML(15), .RD(2), .QLA(4), .QLM(5), .OREG(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/phys/ot_su_lane_hard_defs.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_vstream_lane_t.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_su_lane_t_or/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_su_lane_t_or/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_su_lane_t_or --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hdc_vstream_lane_t --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qfd_su_lane_h/views/ot_hdc_vstream_lane_h --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qfd_su_sfu_exp/views/ot_hdc_sfu_exp_t --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qfd_su_sfu_rcp/views/ot_hdc_sfu_rcp_t --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qfd_su_sfu_rsq/views/ot_hdc_sfu_rsq_t > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
